crop_note: sheet fills scan with narrow paper margin
evidence: Title 'hakuu' (sudden shower); dense slanted rain lines, bamboo grove bent in silhouette, travellers running bent over. Dark grey sky is rain gloom, not night; no seasonal sign.
taxonomy_friction: Genre boundary: the running figures are prominent but the rain-swept slope dominates; chose figures_in_landscape.

crop_note: scan trimmed to the printed image; no visible sheet margin
evidence: White plum blossoms on bare branches, visitors and teahouses in a plum garden: plum season. Salmon-red sky under dark top band is a convention, read as day with a small dusk share; no precipitation.
taxonomy_friction: Strong red sky glow fills much of the sky, which sits on the edge of the 'glow clearly dominates' rule; kept day-dominant.

crop_note: sheet fills scan; light paper margin around printed area is part of the sheet
evidence: Pale unprinted sky under blue top gradation: clear daytime. Terraced fields, thatched farmhouses and straw stacks on rolling hills; no clear seasonal plant or festival.
taxonomy_friction: Straw stacks and the falconer-like figure hint at late autumn/winter but are not strong enough for a marker; no marker for 'harvested field / straw stacks after harvest'.

crop_note: sheet on white backdrop; museum label overlaps lower right corner; pencil title and signature in margin
evidence: Weeping cherry in full bloom propped on poles before a red temple gate, women and children viewing: cherry blossom spring. Even pale beige-grey printed sky reads as soft, slightly overcast daylight.
taxonomy_friction: Shin-hanga printed pale grey/beige skies sit between 'pale unprinted sky = clear' and 'grey sky = cloudy'; had to split. Temple identity (Kita-in) is from my knowledge of the series, not stated in metadata.

place.name: Takuhi shrine (Takibi no yashiro), Nishinoshima, Oki Islands

crop_note: scan trimmed close to the printed image
evidence: Bow of a large ship in choppy teal sea below a wooded shore; no sky shown, no precipitation, no lanterns or moon. The overall dark teal palette may hint at evening (the shrine is known for guiding night fires) but no visible fire or light confirms it.
taxonomy_friction: No sky at all yet clearly outdoors: unclear whether weather should be not_applicable or no_cue (chose no_cue). Breaking waves are rough but not obviously 'violent waves' = storm. Dark overall palette vs. Hiroshige's normal dark sea colour is ambiguous for night. time_source has no value for 'nothing decided it' — used guess with null.

crop_note: sheet fills scan; rounded corner cut-outs are printed
evidence: Title says rain on the plain, but the image shows no rain lines: trees bent hard, leaves flying, travellers and packhorses bowed into the wind under a black sky, so mainly a gale (storm) with a rain share from the title. Black sky is gloom, not night.
taxonomy_friction: Title (rain) and image (wind-only gale) disagree; resolved as storm 0.7 / rain 0.3. Sparse leaves on trees could be early spring or late autumn — no marker fits.

place.name: Hyappongui, east bank of the Sumida near Ryōgoku, Tokyo

taxonomy_friction: Bare-looking shrubs along the fence may suggest winter but are too small to read reliably.

taxonomy_friction: Signature reads Ichiyūsai Hiroshige (early Tōto meisho style) though metadata gives no series; no friction with categories.

crop_note: scan trimmed to sheet; rounded corner cut-outs printed
evidence: Red top band and a broad orange-pink evening glow over the horizon, with a skein of geese flying in and sailboats returning: dusk-leaning. Metadata says Suruga Bay, but the title and image show the Kōnodai cliff over the Edo River, not Suruga.
taxonomy_friction: Geese in a long descending line could be read as wild_geese_descending (rakugan) or wild_geese_flying; chose flying since they are high in the sky, but the two markers peak two months apart.

place.name: Ōmayagashi, west bank of the Sumida, Tokyo

crop_note: full sheet with paper margins in scan
evidence: Grey-green sky darkening at the top, far bank in dark silhouette, hooded streetwalkers (yotaka) waiting at the ferry landing: evening into night, no moon or lanterns. Willow fronds in green leaf.
taxonomy_friction: Evening scene with no lantern or moon: dusk/night split is a judgement call. Print was issued in the 9th month, but the green willow points to late spring/summer; tagged the image.

crop_note: sheet on cream backdrop/mount
evidence: Title 'Sanka hakuu' (shower below the summit): zigzag lightning in the dark lower slopes, while the summit stands in clear blue sky with cumulus clouds. Snow only in streaks near the summit plus summer cumulus suggest summer.
taxonomy_friction: Split-weather scene (storm below, clear above) can only be expressed as a 50/50 vector, which also matches 'partly stormy' conditions. Season cue is atmospheric (thunderstorm, cumulus) plus lingering snow streaks, not plants.
